_comment: Starter practice config for the cpa vertical. A WORKED EXAMPLE, not a recommendation or a benchmark: every number here is invented and must be replaced with your own before any gate result means anything. Run Stage 0 to derive them.

disqualifiers.reason: pressure to start without a written scope
contact must check with an unnamed party
prior suppliers described as incompetent with no self-implication
prior-year records cannot be reconciled and client will not fund clean-up
statutory deadline inside our lead time — accept only with a written late-filing acknowledgement

_walk_away_note: Must equal the walk_away_day_rate computed by economics.py --floor from the costs, capacity and risk blocks above.
